children: Cooper Companies reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue essentially flat year‑over‑year at $1.07B while net income and diluted EPS rose sharply to $432.8M and $2.24, respectively, driven by improvements at CooperVision and service growth at CooperSurgical.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Consolidated net sales were up 5% year‑to‑date, led by CooperVision’s growth in silicone hydrogel lenses and CooperSurgical’s fertility services.
Americas reported mixed results: a Q3 sales decline tied to reduced U.S. channel inventory, but nine‑month growth driven by silicone hydrogel demand.
Brand momentum from MyDay, Biofinity and MiSight supported toric, multifocal and sphere growth across key markets.
Operational initiatives in inventory management, manufacturing and R&D continued to support product rollouts; favorable FX aided nine‑month results.
CooperSurgical recorded material litigation accruals related to recalled embryo culture media, which affected operations and timing of SGA expenses.
